latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of safe-encryption-skill — modern GPG alternative with post-quantum support.

- Encrypt, decrypt, and manage keys using the SAFE CLI and web interface fallback.
- Automatically installs `safe` binary on supported platforms or uses https://thesafe.dev if unavailable.
- Guides interactive password entry, environment variable use, and recipient handling.
- Provides browser automation ARIA labels for web UI integration.
- Enforces secure defaults: absolute file paths, piped data, no temp files.
